topics.title: Lesson 4: Database Integration and Data Management
subtopics: Introduction to NoSQL database into applications
outcomes: Develop competence in full-stack development, encompassing frontend, backend, and database components, enabling them to create end-to-end solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements.

outcomes: Develop full-stack development skills, including frontend development (HTML/CSS, JavaScript), backend development (server-side scripting, databases), and integration with third party APIs and services, to create end-to-end solutions for diverse application domains.

Develop competence in full-stack development, encompassing frontend, backend, and database components, enabling them to create end-to-end solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements.
Design user-friendly interfaces and experiences for integrative programming projects, applying UX design principles and considering user feedback to optimize usability and satisfaction.
Apply agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban to manage integrative programming projects, participating in iterative development cycles and adapting to changing requirements and priorities.

tos.subject: Discreet Mathematics
tos.program: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

topics.title: Chapter 3. Boolean Algebra
outcomes: Analyze the usage of logic gates in evaluating Boolean expressions.
Solve solving complex Boolean expressions through the application of truth tables and logical laws (identity, distributive, commutative, domination)
Demonstrate the ability to convert Boolean expressions to logic gates and vice versa, showcasing creativity and mastery in applying discrete mathematics concepts.

topics.title: Chapter 4. Counting
outcomes: Demonstrate the application of basic computing principles, specifically in the computation of permutations and combinations
Analyze probabilistic outcomes. This involves assessing the significance of expected values in discrete random variables, interpreting their implications, and critically analyzing the results.
Evaluate the variances of discrete random variables, assessing the spread or dispersion of probabilistic outcomes.
